reviews.text: They shouldn't euthanize animals in the first place!

We are transitioning our fur kids over to Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital after having enough of our other veterinary clinic of many years jacking up the prices on their services.

Dr. Kothmann and his team are phenomenal, their prices are fair, and they gave our elderly mastiff such loving care in the last phase of his life. When I picked up his cremated remains, they had made a beautiful paint print of his paw and gave us a little bag of his fur. These gestures meant so much in our time of grieving the loss of our beloved boy.

An extra big thank you to Dr. Kothmann and Maverick!

I can’t say enough good things about Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital and Dr. Christopher LaBrie. Both Pepi and June recently had surgery there, and everyone was genuinely kind, patient, and caring. The entire process was seamless and never felt confusing or overwhelming. That was especially refreshing after dealing with less-than-friendly staff at other veterinary offices.

Their prices were also extremely reasonable and much lower than the quotes I received from a veterinary clinic near the Alamo Heights area. We were able to have both dogs’ procedures done for about what I had been quoted elsewhere for June alone—without sacrificing the quality of care at all.

Dr. LaBrie and his staff made me feel comfortable and confident that Pepi and June were in good hands. I’m incredibly happy with the care we received and so glad we found them!
Excellent staff. Very helpful and caring.

Literally saved my dogs life as we walked in with a emergency due to our dog eating something unknown. The staff was really nice and caring.  The Vet was super nice and informed us of everything as he went along with the exam.  His care and insight of the situation helped my daughter and I feel a lot better.  My dog is back to her normal self and I can't be thankful enough to the hospital!  May God Bless all of you there!

We will be forever grateful to Dr. Kothmann and his staff for their kindness and compassion through a difficult situation. Our beloved Jax of 14 years collapsed. We recognized he needed to be euthanized.
We called our established vet and described what he was experiencing. They responded they were "too busy"to fit us in.
We scrambled to find someone to help as he was in pain and suffering. Thankfully, this wonderful clinic could see us within the hour.
Words can not describe the relief and comfort they provided to us and our dog. Our pets will now be taken care of at Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital. Thank you Courtney, Layla, and Dr, Kothmann.
Sadly my relationship with this place has ended. Dr. Kathmandu  and assistant  gracefully helped my dog go to sleep forever.
Best veterinary services in San Antonio. They truly take the most care for your animals.
Their cool

Super staff! Feel very comfortable bringing my rescues here. There is nothing they cannot do. Thank you all bunches for helping my Uncle Roy (she's a girl). Beth, Layla, Annabel and Maverick, you are all champs! 10 stars!
Great staff, great service! Definitely bringing our little hound here for all her needs.

My first time here. The staff is courteous and professional while also providing excellent care of my Jazmine. Who was scared and shaking. The staff stayed with her and held her while the doctor examined her. They provided information on the care that was being administered. Answered my questions on services they provide and a summary of the cost. I really appreciate that they have an in house lab. The customer service from the front of the house to the medical staff was exceptional.
Always the best pet care for a reasonable price. My pets love Dr. Kothman

Dr LaBrie and his staff are awesome. One of our cats we think was hit by a car. They took us in right away and did a thorough exam and then an X-ray. They were kind and gentle. The service was great and very reasonable pricing.
I take my personal pups and fosters.  Best ever!!

We love this place!  We moved to San Antonio about 2 years ago and needed a new vet.  Terrell Heights came highly recommended and they did not disappoint.
We can usually get in for an appointment same day or next day.
The staff is all very friendly and I find their services, as well as medications, to be very affordable.
I love this vet and the staff! They are compassionate, empathetic, and great with my babes.
Great vets and staff. Very knowledgeable and friendly!

Great pricing, great docs, and great staff! Dr LaBrie had our problem figured out in less than 10 and 10 minutes later we were out the door. I could not have asked for better care. Thank you Terrell Heights Vet Clinic 🧡🥰

I, and many of my friends, used Dr. Kothmann many years ago.  I had moved to the Dallas area, but recently returned to San Antonio.  I was so happy to learn that he was still at the Austin Hwy. location, albeit with a different hospital name.  Recently took in my dog and I was delighted to receive the same knowledgeable vet services that I had enjoyed in the past.  He's not conveniently located near me, but I'll drive as far as needed to see Dr. Kothmann.  My dog is my family and his care is top priority.  The office staff is friendly and efficient and the prices are reasonable.  All around, money and time well spent!

We have used Terrell Heights (formerly Kothmann's) for our rescue kids for many, many years. They understand the hard work of rescue and have always been great partners in that journey. When I had questions on a treatment or why something happened that didn't make sense, the vets have always been so gracious in listening and answering and making recommendations.

I live a distance from them but when I decided not to use my personal vet any more, it was an easy decision to start bringing my own kiddos to them. Yesterday was a perfect example of why. Our older girl was not feeling right and had what I thought was an ear infection.  Dr. Kothmann discovered some lesions, and gently and kindly cleaned her up and made both Mom and pup feel better.

I have so many stories about times they have helped us and listened to us and gave us valuable advice. For us, there is no other choice.
I have to say I absolutely love this vet. Very fair prices, they hear all of my concerns and address them, help me understand everything and are insanely pleasant people in general.

I’m so thankful for Dr. LaBrie, Maverick, and everyone at Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital. They always take the time to explain things in a way that’s easy to understand and make my pets, my fosters, and me feel completely at ease. The current front desk team is friendly, welcoming, and efficient. Highly recommend!

I love this that, I feel so lucky that I found them, the front desk. Staff were very helpful. When I first called I was able to get information and prices, everybody is very patient, empathetic, nice, the doctor took his time to answer all my questions, overall this is just a great practice to take your pet to.

Awesome customer service all of the staff over the phone/in person and of course the veterinarians really caring knowing that my dog was a family member not just a pet.  I highly recommend them if you are looking for a sincerely caring staff and veterinarians
So happy I found this place. It is affordable, they are flexible with scheduling, the staff is always super nice and helpful. The drs are great as well!
Dr. La Brie is kind, gentle and very informative. We appreciate his wonderful staff and the gentle way they handle our dogs.
The doctor is great, the staff at the front desk is not. Sadly, we’re having to find another vet for that reason.

I followed Dr. LaBrie from another veterinary. He took great care of my Chiweenie, Tyler. During Tyler's Type 1 Diabetes, Dr LaBrie showed me how to give shots and take blood. He now takes care of all my fur kids. Fortunately, so far, all three are healthy. This also got my sister to move her fur kids to this Vetinary Hospital. Dr. LaBrie really cares and is very knowledgeable.
Quick and simple. The people working there are wonderful.

Had my first appointment yesterday with my young dog. The receptionist was very accommodating, kind and patient as I was waiting for my husband to arrive at the vets so he could help me take our large, energetic puppy inside:) The doctor was very kind and helpful and gave us a great experience. Our dog, Henry, also liked our Doctor, Christopher LaBrie. Henry’s symptoms have already vanished overnight with the treatment he prescribed us.
There is no other vet clinic I trust more. I always highly recommend taking your little loves here.

absolute most best place to take your fur babies. my cat was a wee bit matted and suffering from a rash and tummy troubles; the vet was efficient and friendly while he explained to me what was going on, what he was going to do and how best to continue treating her after. i will highly recommend this vet to anyone with a fur baby

II adore this hospital,I've had experiences with both doctors, who saved my kitten's life. Now, I take my cats only to Terrell hights vet hospital. Thank you very much for scheduling appointments so quickly and for caring for our furry babies ❤️❤️❤️. Much love and endless gratitude to everyone who works there

They are all super kind and know how to comfort us parents of fur babies. The Doctor's know their stuff. We will be forever grateful for all that they do.
Thanks Brutus & Rocky 4

Very thorough, very compassionate, knowledgeable veterinarian Dr Kothman and staff. I was able to get an appointment quickly and I took 2 of my dogs. The cost for 2 dogs was less than I have had to pay for 1 dog at other veterinary clinics. I highly recommend.
Great service from the staff, highly recommended!
Very nice place nice vet techs and Dr great atmosphere had a great experience
Chris is a beautiful man  and takes special care of my dogs
Excellent veterinary care and responsive office.

I cannot express enough gratitude for the incredible care provided by the team at Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital, especially Dr. Chris Labrie, Dr. John Kothmann, and their amazing staff member, Sage. Moose, my beloved companion and best friend, has been a patient here for years, and every visit—whether routine or critical—has been marked by professionalism, kindness, and an unwavering dedication to his well-being.

When Moose recently developed an unexpected health issue, Dr. Labrie stepped in immediately. His calm demeanor and extensive knowledge reassured me during a deeply emotional and overwhelming time. He performed the necessary diagnostics, identified a liver issue, and carefully explained every step of the process to me with patience and compassion. Dr. Labrie’s ability to collaborate with other professionals and ensure continuity of care has been invaluable—he truly goes above and beyond for his patients.

Though he wasn’t involved in Moose’s recent emergency, Dr. John Kothmann has been a trusted part of Moose’s care for years. His attention to detail and dedication to routine wellness have been instrumental in keeping Moose happy and healthy over the years. Knowing that both Dr. Labrie and Dr. Kothmann are in Moose’s corner gives me a sense of trust and comfort that’s hard to put into words.

Additionally, I want to give A special shoutout to Sage, who embodies everything you could ask for in a veterinary staff member. She is kind, attentive, efficient, and truly passionate about the pets and people she serves. Whether she’s answering the phone, assisting in the clinic, or greeting us at the front desk, Sage always goes above and beyond to ensure every interaction is smooth, informative, and comforting. Her genuine care and positive energy make a huge difference, especially during stressful moments. She is truly a rockstar, and Terrell Heights is lucky to have her.

Whether it’s routine checkups, challenging medical situations, or just day-to-day interactions, the team at Terrell Heights Veterinary Hospital consistently goes the extra mile for their patients and their families. Their kindness, professionalism, and genuine love for animals shine through in everything they do. I’m so thankful to have Moose under the care of such an exceptional team. They’ve truly earned my trust and gratitude.
Excellent care given by vets who treat dogs as dogs.

Dr. LaBrie and his staff were amazing. We have 3 dogs (one super senior mutt, one newly senior puppy mill special and one psychotic anxious freak) and he was kind and caring to each of their individual needs. It was also the most informative vet visit I have had listing out multiple diagnosis possibilities, treatment options and next steps. I am so happy I have made this office the veterinary home for my dogs and won’t be changing.
The Best Vet Ive been too!❤️❤️🐕 …
